violated_contract: A sign-in provider error (an Apple authorization failure, a Firebase rejection of the provider token) must reach the caller with its code. It must not be swallowed into a null result that the caller then reports and presents as the user cancelling, because analytics and the on-screen message can no longer tell a refusal from a dismissal.
canonical_prevention: Provider sign-in calls throw instead of returning null on failure; the error is classified once, in the shared sign-in failure classifier, into cancel versus failure class plus a closed provider code, and both analytics and the shown message read that single classification.
